1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronVertexAvoidance
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FinitelyManyShortestRoutes
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.ShortestFiniteDevelopments
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.ShortestSourceImages
5 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GeodesicFibers
6 
7 /-! Apply all-vertex avoidance to the existing finite-development and
8 nonbranching arguments. These results now cover the universal-vertex
9 solids as well as the earlier four canonical graph models. -/
10 
11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
12 
13 open Set
14 
15 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
16   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
17     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
18   {a b : Space}
19 
20 include size small_faces in
21 /-- Distinct endpoints admit only finitely many normalized shortest routes. -/
22 theorem small_finite_shortest_routes (different : a ≠ b) :
23     {path : P.SurfacePath a b | path.IsShortest ∧ path.length ≠ ⊤ ∧
24       LipschitzWith path.length.toNNReal path.curve}.Finite := by
25   apply (P.finite_vertex_free_shortest_routes a b).subset
26   intro path hp
27   exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2,
28     small_shortest_lipschitz_avoids_vertices size small_faces path different hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2⟩
29 
30 include size small_faces in
31 /-- Each compact normalized geodesic fiber between distinct endpoints is finite. -/
32 theorem small_geodesicFiber_finite (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b) :
33     (P.geodesicFiber a b).Finite := by
34   have paths := small_finite_shortest_routes size small_faces
35     (fun h : (a : Space) = (b : Space) => different (Subtype.ext h))
36   apply (paths.image SurfacePath.boundaryCurve).subset
37   intro f hf
38   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite, speed, same⟩ := P.geodesicFiber_path a b f hf
39   exact ⟨path, ⟨shortest, finite, speed⟩, same⟩
40 
41 include size small_faces in
42 /-- Intrinsic distance is one of the finite original-face development formulas. -/
43 theorem small_surfaceDist_mem_developed_values
44     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b) :
45     P.surfaceDist a b ∈ P.developedDistanceValues a b := by
46   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite, speed, _, avoids⟩ :=
47     small_exists_vertex_avoiding_shortest_path size small_faces ha hb different
48   exact path.surfaceDist_mem_developed_values shortest finite speed avoids
49 
50 include size small_faces in
51 /-- At a unique-face target, one of the finite source copies gives the exact distance. -/
52 theorem small_exists_source_image
53     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b)
54     (F : P.Face) (unique : ∀ G : P.Face, b ∈ G.val → G = F) :
55     ∃ source ∈ P.sourceImages a F, P.surfaceDist a b = dist source (P.faceCoordinates F b) := by
56   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite, speed, _, avoids⟩ :=
57     small_exists_vertex_avoiding_shortest_path size small_faces ha hb different
58   exact path.exists_source_image shortest finite speed avoids F unique
59 
60 include size small_faces in
61 /-- Two shortest routes with the same endpoints coincide if they meet internally. -/
62 theorem small_shortest_routes_agree_of_meeting
63     (first second : P.SurfacePath a b) (different : a ≠ b)
64     (first_shortest : first.IsShortest) (second_shortest : second.IsShortest)
65     (first_finite : first.length ≠ ⊤) (second_finite : second.length ≠ ⊤)
66     (first_speed : LipschitzWith first.length.toNNReal first.curve)
67     (second_speed : LipschitzWith second.length.toNNReal second.curve)
68     (m : unitInterval) (after_start : 0 < m) (before_end : m < 1)
69     (meet : first.curve m = second.curve m) : ∀ t, first.curve t = second.curve t :=
70   first.agree_of_interior_meeting second first_shortest second_shortest first_finite second_finite
71     first_speed second_speed
72     (small_shortest_lipschitz_avoids_vertices size small_faces first different first_shortest
73       first_finite first_speed) m after_start before_end meet
74 
75 include size small_faces in
76 /-- Distinct shortest routes have disjoint open traces. -/
77 theorem small_distinct_shortest_routes_disjoint
78     (first second : P.SurfacePath a b) (different : a ≠ b)
79     (first_shortest : first.IsShortest) (second_shortest : second.IsShortest)
80     (first_finite : first.length ≠ ⊤) (second_finite : second.length ≠ ⊤)
81     (first_speed : LipschitzWith first.length.toNNReal first.curve)
82     (second_speed : LipschitzWith second.length.toNNReal second.curve)
83     (distinct_routes : ¬ ∀ t, first.curve t = second.curve t) :
84     Disjoint (first.curve '' Ioo (0 : unitInterval) 1) (second.curve '' Ioo (0 : unitInterval) 1) :=
85   first.disjoint_open_traces second different first_shortest second_shortest first_finite second_finite
86     first_speed second_speed
87     (small_shortest_lipschitz_avoids_vertices size small_faces first different first_shortest
88       first_finite first_speed) distinct_routes
89 
90 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
